newsitem.title: UK: Ingersoll-Rand says owns 96.9 pct of Newman.
newsitem.headline: Ingersoll-Rand says owns 96.9 pct of Newman.

text.p: U.S. industrial machinery company Ingersoll-Rand said on Thursday it is set to acquire 96.9 percent in British building products company Newman Tonks.
The shares, about 119.34 million, has been acquired through one of its subsidiaries, NT Acquisition.
Ingersoll-Rand said it had posted compulsory acquisition notices to all holders of Newman Tonks ordinary shares who have not yet accepted the offer.
The transfer of the compulsorily-acquired Newman Tonks shares will take place on or after May 29.
Ingersol-Rand made a recommended 230-million stg cash offer for Newman Tonks in January and blocked a rival hostile 195.7 million stg offer from British engineering firm FKI Plc.
